summary: Iteration 8 testing complete. Backend 11/11 passing (payment link creation + persistence, auth guards, Stripe webhook sig rejection, cron auth, admin manual cron run with sent>=1, regression on holidays/pricing/reservations, crons.yml YAML parse). Frontend: public 'Pagamento' nav scrolls to #pagamento; payment-methods-section with 3 SVG badges (Visa/Mastercard/Elo) and btn-request-payment-link visible. Admin Reservations table shows Hóspede/Quarto/Datas/Reservado em/Origem/Pagamento/Status/Ações; res-created-{id} shows pt-BR datetime, res-source-{id} shows origem label; clicking gen-paylink-{id} on a non-zero reservation shows pay-status='Aguardando' + send-paylink icon. Admin Calendar bars show enriched title tooltip (guest/origem/reservado em/status) and day dialog shows day-res-source-{id} with origin + 'reservado em <datetime>'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~2066 lines — consider splitting into routers (reservations, stripe, cron, pricing).

_run_checkin_reminder uses asyncio.create_task(_fire_webhook) and increments 'sent' regardless of webhook config — count may overstate deliveries when webhook URL is empty. Consider only incrementing when webhook actually fired or rename field to 'matched'.
stripe webhook catch of generic Exception returns 400 even for transient parsing errors; may want 500 for non-signature issues to let Stripe retry.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_QA Hospede reservations via /api/reservations during pytest runs (checkin today+3, today+20). Visible in UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 iteration-8 features working end-to-end. Backend pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8.py is idempotent and safe to rerun.
